query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Automate and refine a complex Google Sheets financial/workforce model: apply formatting, dropdown validation, filters, formulas, instructional text, payroll-style calculations, and employee allocation logic across multiple worksheets.
query_ground_truth.query: apply advanced cell formatting and data validation dropdowns in Google Sheets
query_ground_truth.intent: Apply custom formatting rules and restrict cell inputs using dropdown validation across spreadsheet worksheets.

results.use_case: apply advanced cell formatting and data validation dropdowns in Google Sheets
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Resolve target worksheet and numeric sheet_id using GOOGLESHEETS_GET_SPREADSHEET_INFO (avoid writing to the wrong tab).

[Optional (if ranges/headers/formulas are uncertain)] [Prerequisite]: Read a small header+sample window using GOOGLESHEETS_BATCH_GET (use formatted values; optionally also read formulas to spot error-like outputs before applying rules).
[Optional (if headers/defaults must be set first)] [Step]: Write header cells or initial TRUE/FALSE values using GOOGLESHEETS_VALUES_UPDATE (confirm placement via updatedRange).
[Required] [Step]: Apply baseline styling (header fill/bold/alignment) using GOOGLESHEETS_FORMAT_CELL.
[Required] [Step]: Add/replace dropdown or checkbox rules using GOOGLESHEETS_SET_DATA_VALIDATION_RULE (use mode="CLEAR" then mode="SET"; BOOLEAN for checkboxes; grid ranges are index-based).
[Optional (if you need to reset conditional formatting first)] [Prerequisite]: Inspect existing rule indices using GOOGLESHEETS_GET_CONDITIONAL_FORMAT_RULES (capture ordering before mutations).
[Required] [Step]: Add/update per-value coloring using GOOGLESHEETS_MUTATE_CONDITIONAL_FORMAT_RULES (ADD rules such as TEXT_EQ; if deleting multiple rules, delete highest index first).

[Optional (for verification/audits)] [Next Step]: Confirm applied rules using GOOGLESHEETS_GET_DATA_VALIDATION_RULES and GOOGLESHEETS_GET_CONDITIONAL_FORMAT_RULES (optionally re-check display via GOOGLESHEETS_BATCH_GET).

[Fallback (if metadata is truncated/offloaded and sheet_id can’t be read reliably)] [Fallback]: Extract sheet_id/title from the saved payload using COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH, then retry writes with the resolved sheet_id.
known_pitfalls: [GOOGLESHEETS_SET_DATA_VALIDATION_RULE] Grid ranges use 0-based indices and end_*_index values are exclusive; off-by-one errors can omit the last row/column or include headers unintentionally.
[GOOGLESHEETS_SET_DATA_VALIDATION_RULE] mode is required and case-sensitive ("SET"/"CLEAR"); when mode="SET", validation_type is required or the call fails.
[GOOGLESHEETS_GET_SPREADSHEET_INFO] Large spreadsheets can return oversized metadata that is truncated/offloaded; sheetId may need to be taken from the saved payload rather than the inline response.
[GOOGLESHEETS_BATCH_GET] valueRanges[].values may be absent for blank ranges, and read-heavy usage can hit HTTP 429; batch ranges and retry with backoff.
[GOOGLESHEETS_MUTATE_CONDITIONAL_FORMAT_RULES] Deleting multiple conditional format rules by index can shift later indices; plan deletions from highest index to lowest.

GOOGLESHEETS_SET_DATA_VALIDATION_RULE.description: Tool to set or clear data validation rules (including dropdowns) on a range in Google Sheets. Use when you need to apply dropdown lists, range-based dropdowns, or custom formula validation to cells.

mode.description: Operation mode: 'SET' applies a validation rule to the range, 'CLEAR' removes any existing validation from the range.

strict.description: Whether to reject invalid data (true) or show a warning (false). Default is true.

values.description: List of allowed values for dropdown. Required when validation_type='ONE_OF_LIST'. Each item becomes a dropdown option.

formula.description: Custom formula for validation. Required when validation_type='CUSTOM_FORMULA'. Formula should evaluate to TRUE/FALSE. Example: '=A1>10'.

sheet_id.description: The unique sheet ID (numeric identifier) where the validation rule will be applied. The first sheet created in a spreadsheet typically has ID 0, while additional sheets get unique IDs (e.g., 1534097477). If a sheet is deleted, its ID is never reused - so if the original first sheet (ID 0) was deleted, attempting to use 0 will fail. Always verify the actual sheet ID exists using GOOGLESHEETS_GET_SPREADSHEET_INFO action (check 'sheets[].properties.sheetId' field).

end_row_index.description: Ending row index (0-based, exclusive) for the validation range. To apply to row 1 only, use start_row_index=0 and end_row_index=1.

input_message.description: Optional message shown to the user when they select the cell. Helpful hint about what values are expected.

show_custom_ui.description: Whether to show a dropdown UI for list-based validation. Default is true. Set to true for dropdown lists.

spreadsheet_id.description: The unique identifier of the Google Sheets spreadsheet. Can be found in the spreadsheet URL between '/d/' and '/edit'.

source_range_a1.description: Source range in A1 notation for dropdown values. Required when validation_type='ONE_OF_RANGE'. Example: 'Sheet1!A1:A10' or 'A1:A10'.

start_row_index.description: Starting row index (0-based, inclusive) for the validation range. Row 1 is index 0.

validation_type.description: Type of validation rule to apply. Required when mode='SET'. Dropdown types: 'ONE_OF_LIST' (dropdown from list), 'ONE_OF_RANGE' (dropdown from range). Number validations: 'NUMBER_GREATER', 'NUMBER_GREATER_THAN_EQ', 'NUMBER_LESS', 'NUMBER_LESS_THAN_EQ', 'NUMBER_EQ', 'NUMBER_NOT_EQ', 'NUMBER_BETWEEN', 'NUMBER_NOT_BETWEEN'. Text validations: 'TEXT_CONTAINS', 'TEXT_NOT_CONTAINS', 'TEXT_EQ', 'TEXT_NOT_EQ', 'TEXT_IS_EMAIL', 'TEXT_IS_URL' (Note: TEXT_STARTS_WITH and TEXT_ENDS_WITH are only for conditional formatting, not data validation). Date validations: 'DATE_EQ', 'DATE_BEFORE', 'DATE_AFTER', 'DATE_ON_OR_BEFORE', 'DATE_ON_OR_AFTER', 'DATE_BETWEEN', 'DATE_NOT_BETWEEN', 'DATE_NOT_EQ', 'DATE_IS_VALID'. Other: 'BLANK', 'NOT_BLANK', 'BOOLEAN', 'CUSTOM_FORMULA'.

condition_values.description: Generic list of condition values for validation types that require specific values (e.g., NUMBER_GREATER requires one value, NUMBER_BETWEEN requires two values, TEXT_CONTAINS requires one value). For simple validations like TEXT_IS_EMAIL, BLANK, NOT_BLANK, BOOLEAN, DATE_IS_VALID, this can be omitted. Each value should be a string that will be parsed by Google Sheets.

end_column_index.description: Ending column index (0-based, exclusive) for the validation range. To apply to column A only, use start_column_index=0 and end_column_index=1.

start_column_index.description: Starting column index (0-based, inclusive) for the validation range. Column A is index 0.

filtered_rows_included.description: Whether to apply validation to rows hidden by filters. Default is false. Set to true to ensure validation applies to both visible and filtered rows.

GOOGLESHEETS_MUTATE_CONDITIONAL_FORMAT_R.description: Add, update, delete, or reorder conditional format rules on a Google Sheet. Use when you need to create, modify, or remove conditional formatting without manually building batchUpdate requests. Supports four operations: ADD (create new rule), UPDATE (replace existing rule), DELETE (remove rule), MOVE (reorder rules by changing index).

sheetId.description: The sheet ID containing this range.

items.description: Range in a sheet where conditional formatting applies.

ranges.description: Ranges where formatting applies (must be on same sheet).

themeColor.description: Theme color reference (TEXT, BACKGROUND, ACCENT1-6, LINK, etc.).

foregroundColorStyle.description: Color style using either RGB or theme color.

textFormat.description:
Text formatting options for conditional formatting.

IMPORTANT: Only bold, italic, strikethrough, and foreground color are supported
in conditional formatting. Fields like fontSize, fontFamily, and underline are NOT
supported and will cause API errors if included.

themeColor.description: Theme color reference (TEXT, BACKGROUND, ACCENT1-6, LINK, etc.).

backgroundColorStyle.description: Color style using either RGB or theme color.

format.description: Formatting to apply when condition is true.

type.description: Condition type. Valid values: NUMBER_GREATER, NUMBER_GREATER_THAN_EQ, NUMBER_LESS, NUMBER_LESS_THAN_EQ, NUMBER_EQ, NUMBER_NOT_EQ, NUMBER_BETWEEN, NUMBER_NOT_BETWEEN, TEXT_CONTAINS, TEXT_NOT_CONTAINS, TEXT_STARTS_WITH, TEXT_ENDS_WITH, TEXT_EQ, TEXT_NOT_EQ, TEXT_IS_EMAIL, TEXT_IS_URL, DATE_EQ, DATE_BEFORE, DATE_AFTER, DATE_ON_OR_BEFORE, DATE_ON_OR_AFTER, DATE_BETWEEN, DATE_NOT_BETWEEN, DATE_NOT_EQ, DATE_IS_VALID, ONE_OF_RANGE, ONE_OF_LIST, BLANK, NOT_BLANK, CUSTOM_FORMULA, BOOLEAN, FILTER_EXPRESSION.

relativeDate.description: Relative date value (PAST_YEAR, PAST_MONTH, PAST_WEEK, YESTERDAY, TODAY, TOMORROW). Valid only for DATE_BEFORE, DATE_AFTER, DATE_ON_OR_BEFORE, or DATE_ON_OR_AFTER condition types.

userEnteredValue.description: Value as entered by user (formula, number, or text). Always provide as a string, even for numeric values (e.g., '0.01' not 0.01). For CUSTOM_FORMULA conditions: formulas must begin with '=' or '+'; the formula must evaluate to true/false; same-sheet references work normally (e.g., '=A1>100'); cross-sheet references require INDIRECT function (use '=COUNTIF(INDIRECT("Sheet2!A:A"),A1)>0' instead of '=COUNTIF(Sheet2!A:A,A1)>0'). The value is parsed by Google Sheets as if typed into a cell.

value.description: Value when type is NUMBER, PERCENT, or PERCENTILE.

themeColor.description: Theme color reference (TEXT, BACKGROUND, ACCENT1-6, LINK, etc.).

colorStyle.description: Color style using either RGB or theme color.

colorStyle.description: Color style using either RGB or theme color.

index.description: Zero-based index for the operation. Required for UPDATE, DELETE, MOVE. Optional for ADD (defaults to end of list).

sheet_id.description: The unique numeric identifier of the sheet/tab to modify (NOT a zero-based index). This is a specific ID assigned by Google Sheets when the sheet is created, not the position of the sheet. You MUST first call GOOGLESHEETS_GET_SPREADSHEET_INFO to retrieve the actual sheetId values from the 'sheets' array in the response. Common mistake: Do not assume sheet_id=0 exists - while some spreadsheets may have a sheet with ID 0, many do not.

new_index.description: Destination index for MOVE operation. Required when operation is MOVE.

operation.description: Operation type: ADD (add new rule), UPDATE (replace rule), DELETE (remove rule), MOVE (change rule order/index).

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet containing the sheet to modify. Found in the Google Sheets URL between '/d/' and '/edit'.

GOOGLESHEETS_GET_SPREADSHEET_INFO.description: Retrieves metadata for a Google Spreadsheet using its ID. By default, returns essential information (ID, title, sheet properties) to avoid payload size issues. Use the fields parameter for comprehensive metadata or specific fields.

fields.description: Optional. Field mask specifying which fields to return. Uses Google's field mask syntax (comma-separated, dot-notation for nested fields). If not specified, a default mask returning common fields (spreadsheet ID, title, sheet properties) is applied to avoid payload size issues. For full metadata, use '*' (not recommended for large spreadsheets). When set, includeGridData is ignored. Examples: 'sheets.properties(sheetId,title)', 'properties.title,sheets.properties.sheetId'.

ranges.description: Optional. The ranges to retrieve from the spreadsheet, specified using A1 notation (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:D5', 'Sheet2!A1:C4'). Multiple ranges can be requested simultaneously. If not specified, metadata for the entire spreadsheet is returned without grid data.

spreadsheet_id.description: Required. The Google Sheets spreadsheet ID or full URL. Accepts either the ID alone (e.g., '1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms') or a full Google Sheets URL (e.g., 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms/edit'). The ID will be automatically extracted from URLs. Note: Published/embedded URLs (containing '/d/e/2PACX-...') are not supported.

include_grid_data.description: Optional. If true, grid data will be returned. This parameter is ignored if a field mask was set in the request. When false or not specified, only metadata is returned without cell values.

exclude_tables_in_banded_ranges.description: Optional. If true, tables within banded ranges will be omitted from the response. Default is false when not specified.
